Venonat

Bug Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Venonat is a Bug/Poison-type Insect Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 30 kg. It evolves into Venomoth. Its highest base stat is HP (60), with a base stat total of 305.
